stories.title: Oliver Wyman to acquire Synpulse
stories.summary: Oliver Wyman has agreed to acquire Synpulse, a technology and AI platform company serving financial institutions. The firms have already delivered multiple end-to-end transformations for clients, and the deal is expected to close in early 2027. Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

stories.title: Oliver Wyman to acquire technology consulting firm Synpulse - Reinsurance News
stories.summary: Oliver Wyman, a global management consulting firm and a Marsh business, has entered into an agreement to acquire Synpulse, a global technology consulting and AI platform company. Banks, insurers and asset managers are facing significant changes driven by advances in technology, data and AI, alongside evolving business models. As these

McKinsey suggests global firms partner with China
stories.summary: McKinsey Greater China chairman Joe Ngai said multinational companies can work with Chinese partners to develop products for global markets. He made the remarks at the launch of the Chinese edition of The Next China Is Still China in Shanghai on November 25, 2026.

McKinsey says companies are tightening AI spending
stories.summary: Companies are tightening spending controls and using more efficient AI models to manage rising expenses, according to a McKinsey report. The firm suggests that high token use can represent either extraordinary productivity or substantial waste, making cost per outcome more important than token volume alone.

stories.title: Primus Partners reports on CSR in Northeast India
stories.summary: Primus Partners released a report on CSR investments in Northeast India at the CII North East CSR Connect. The firm notes that while CSR funding in the region has tripled in four years, the area still receives 2.1 percent of India's total CSR investment.

stories.title: India’s debt-to-GDP ratio set to fall to 75.1% by 2031, defying global trend: EY - Firstpost
McKinsey projects India steel demand
stories.summary: McKinsey estimates that India's steel demand will reach 250 to 280 million tonnes by 2035. The projection was included in a broader industry outlook alongside advice for first-time home buyers and updates on the terracotta breeze block market.

stories.title: McKinsey says AI will reshape work for minority groups
stories.summary: Black and Latino workers are 20 percent more likely than White workers to need new occupations by 2035 as AI reshapes the labor market, according to the McKinsey Institute for Economic Mobility. Automation could displace 40 percent of work hours currently held by Black and Latino employees.

stories.title: BCG report on clean energy transition
stories.summary: Battery storage, green hydrogen and bioenergy remain dependent on policy support to scale, according to a BCG and IVCA report. While investment flows into established renewable energy, these emerging technologies face challenges in securing long-term financing and commercial returns.

stories.title: India climate equity funding reaches $31 billion
stories.summary: India attracted nearly $31 billion in climate and sustainability equity funding between 2021 and 2026, according to a BCG and IVCA report. Power, low-carbon fuels and transport accounted for over 90 percent of this capital. The country requires $22 to 24 trillion in investment by 2070.

stories.title: BCG and CII target $100 billion in textile exports
stories.summary: India's textile industry is targeting $100 billion in exports by FY31, requiring annual growth of over 20 percent, according to a BCG and CII report. The ambition assumes exports will rise to 30 percent of the total market, up from the current 20 percent share.

stories.title: McKinsey warns of European industrial job losses
stories.summary: Approximately 3.7 million European industrial jobs are at risk due to financial strain, according to a McKinsey report. The firm found that 45 percent of analyzed industrial businesses were stressed or distressed in 2025, exposing over 500 billion euros in value added to economic output.

stories.title: Rise Consulting Group and Mitsubishi launch digital joint venture Mill-Box
stories.summary: Rise Consulting Group and Mitsubishi have established Mill-Box, a Tokyo-based venture aimed at accelerating digital transformation in materials and construction. Mitsubishi holds an 80 percent stake in the new entity. The partnership intends to address fragmented information and paper-based processes in the sector. Paper remains a persistent competitor.

stories.title: Bain Capital’s Luca Bassi Picks His Next Flywheel Investment - Bloomberg
Nubank’s rise reshapes competition and bank M&A
stories.summary: Nubank’s growth has accelerated digital transformation among Brazil’s largest banks and raised entry barriers for new competitors, according to Bain & Company. Traditional lenders are responding by increasing technology investment and pursuing acquisitions to bolster their artificial intelligence capabilities. Incumbents are now better prepared for the newcomers.

stories.title: Moelis & Company offers 5 percent dividend yield after stock decline
stories.summary: Moelis & Company shares have declined 25 percent year to date. The investment bank now offers a 5 percent dividend yield, with its valuation based on a 15x forward earnings multiple and expectations for a record deal pipeline. The market is pricing in a significant jump in future earnings.

stories.title: Bain Capital Euro CLO 2025-1 DAC notes affirmed as Fitch removes watch on class D and E - Traders Union
India attracts $31 billion in climate equity funding
stories.summary: India secured $31 billion in climate and sustainability equity funding between 2021 and October 2026. The capital is heavily concentrated, with $19 billion directed toward power and low-carbon fuels and $9.5 billion toward transport. Other sectors like agriculture and waste management have received significantly less attention from investors.

stories.title: India’s InsurTech sector reaches $14.7 billion valuation
stories.summary: India’s InsurTech sector now comprises over 150 companies with a combined valuation exceeding $14.7 billion. While global funding rose 9 percent in 2025, domestic funding in India stabilized at $120 million. Distribution remains the primary focus, drawing 69 percent of domestic capital compared to 22 percent globally.

stories.title: Private equity and venture capital investments reach $8.7 billion
stories.summary: Private equity and venture capital investments in India hit $8.7 billion in October 2026, a 21 percent increase over September and 62 percent higher than October 2025. This marks the highest monthly level in five years, according to the latest EY-IVCA report. The market is currently trending upward.

stories.title: Telecom M&A deal value reaches $75 billion
stories.summary: Telecommunications companies are increasingly using mergers and acquisitions to evolve business models amid industry deregulation and competitive threats. Global deal value reached $75 billion during the first three quarters of 2026. The integrated telco model is currently being replaced by more disaggregated and narrowly focused business structures.

stories.title: India’s renewable power capacity reaches 560 GW
stories.summary: India’s installed power capacity reached approximately 560 GW by October 2026. Non-fossil capacity crossed 308 GW by July, accounting for 55 percent of the total. The government maintains that rapid scaling is possible when policy, markets, investment, and technology align. The grid is now doing the heavy lifting.

stories.title: Niti Aayog reviews import dependence on capital goods
stories.summary: Niti Aayog is weighing regulatory measures to reduce reliance on foreign capital goods. Officials are investigating bottlenecks in domestic manufacturing and the risks posed by critical component imports from countries like China. The government is concerned about the leverage held by foreign suppliers in the global supply chain.

stories.title: PwC India opens AI experience lab in Gurugram
stories.summary: PwC India has launched an experiential AI lab in Gurugram to assist businesses with hands-on experimentation. The firm aims to help leaders navigate the shift from pilot projects to autonomous agents and physical AI. Business leaders are currently asking how much to govern and how quickly to invest.

stories.title: Manufacturing sector marks 12 years of Make in India reforms
stories.summary: India’s manufacturing sector is focusing on self-reliance through initiatives like the Production Linked Incentive scheme and the National Logistics Policy. The government aims to position the country as a global hub for defence, pharmaceuticals, and heavy machinery. The nation is currently celebrating its 80th Independence Day.

stories.title: India requires $500 billion annually for net zero
stories.summary: India needs $500 billion per year to reach net zero emissions by 2070, according to a report by the Indian Venture and Alternate Capital Association and Boston Consulting Group. Current annual investment is approximately $135 billion. The funding gap remains a significant hurdle for the transition.

stories.title: NITI Aayog identifies four key sectors to position India as global manufacturing hub - DD News
PwC suggests strategic gas and LPG reserves for India
stories.summary: PwC India suggests that the country should expand strategic energy reserves to include natural gas and LPG to protect consumers from global price shocks. Current storage is primarily focused on crude oil. Recent disruptions near the Strait of Hormuz have highlighted the need for diversified energy security.

stories.title: Climate funding in India remains concentrated in power and transport
stories.summary: Over 90 percent of India's climate and sustainability equity funding is directed toward power, low-carbon fuels, and transport. A report by BCG and the IVCA notes that emerging sectors such as green hydrogen and energy storage face a significant funding gap. Capital prefers the established segments.

stories.title: Niti Aayog reports gains in school education access
stories.summary: A new Niti Aayog report indicates improvements in school infrastructure, digital learning, and student enrollment over the past decade. The assessment notes a recovery in foundational literacy and numeracy following the pandemic. The government has proposed a roadmap to continue these gains in electricity and internet connectivity.

stories.title: Priya Ramdev Appointed People Lead for India and Global Capability Centre at Alvarez & Marsal - https://hrtoday.in/
Campus recruitment remains a fixture in India
stories.summary: Campus placements continue to serve as a primary bridge between Indian higher education and the job market. Companies across consulting, finance, and technology sectors participate in these organised programmes to identify talent. The ecosystem remains a standard component of the professional pipeline for thousands of graduates each year.

stories.title: University of Dubai and Accenture partner on skills
stories.summary: The University of Dubai and Accenture have launched a collaboration to provide industry modules for over 1,000 students. Accenture will design content while the university retains control over its own curriculum and academic credentials. The programme aims to help students prepare for a changing world of work.

stories.title: PwC and British Deputy High Commission host cricket match
stories.summary: PwC India and the British Deputy High Commission in Kolkata organised a cricket match this Tuesday to promote inclusion. The event, titled Beyond Boundaries, featured differently abled cricketers from the West Bengal Cricket Association alongside women players and corporate representatives. The participants shared the field for the day.

stories.title: KPMG survey finds background checks are shifting
stories.summary: KPMG in India reports that organisations are moving to treat background verification as a strategic risk management function rather than a routine hiring task. While screening is nearly universal, the survey notes persistent gaps in governance and continuous monitoring. Trust is now being reimagined as a corporate function.

stories.title: ISB Young Leaders cohort reports placement results
stories.summary: The Indian School of Business announced that its 130-student Young Leaders cohort received over 200 offers from 45 companies. The cohort, which averages nine months of prior work experience, secured positions with firms including McKinsey, Bain, and Google. The programme continues to place students before their final year.

stories.title: Newton School of Technology reports 98.3 percent placement
stories.summary: Newton School of Technology announced that 98.3 percent of its Pune cohort secured placements before their third year. Nearly one in three of these roles are within AI and data companies. The cohort of 313 students found opportunities across 173 different employers.

stories.title: ISB PGP YL Second Cohort Records Strong Summer Internship Placements: Key Highlights - Shiksha.com
ISB Young Leaders cohort reports stipend data
stories.summary: The Indian School of Business reported that its second Young Leaders cohort received over 200 offers, with the highest two-month stipend reaching Rs 7.9 lakh. The average stipend for the 130-student group was Rs 3.44 lakh. The cohort averages nine months of work experience prior to the programme.
